snippet.title: PLAINS OF PAIN | Official Trailer | Post-Apo Survival Sandbox
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official trailer for Plains of Pain.
This update brings the Dustborns capital Lost Wings City, expanded base building, reworked traders, and a huge step toward version 1.0

Every clip in this trailer was recorded directly in-game using our Cinematic Mod
No postproduction, no scripted scenes, no visual effects
Just pure raw gameplay captured straight from the world of Plains of Pain

You can activate the Cinematic Mod yourself anytime in-game by pressing F4

Steam store:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218970/Plains_of_Pain/

Want to join the community and talk with the developers
Come hang out on our official Discord
👉 https://discord.gg/quWRy8Bp

See you in the wasteland survivor

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218970/Plains_of_Pain/
